knowledge.name: Synthetic RFP and opportunity snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed records hold three allow-listed RFPs, stakeholders, budgets, requirements, timelines, and existing proposal assets.

knowledge.name: Product and pricing catalog
knowledge.detail: Bundled products, industry solution configurations, discount rules, costs, and margin floors drive deterministic pricing.

knowledge.name: Reference and competitive evidence
knowledge.detail: Synthetic references, availability flags, competitor capabilities, and differentiators support governed positioning drafts.

knowledge.name: Approved response content seam
knowledge.detail: SharePoint is the approved production content seam; current evidence remains the uploaded synthetic snapshot only.

intelligence_processing.name: RFP requirement analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Extracts requirements and maps each one to available capability evidence in a traceable checklist.

intelligence_processing.name: Weighted capability fit scoring
intelligence_processing.detail: Applies deterministic fit scores and requirement weights to calculate an illustrative overall match.

intelligence_processing.name: Buyer-aligned executive drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds a reviewable executive summary from stated priorities, capability matches, pricing, and references.

intelligence_processing.name: Pricing and margin analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates line-item discounts, proposed totals, budget headroom, savings, and margins without approval.

intelligence_processing.name: Reference and competitor positioning
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks references by industry relevance and creates a comparison matrix and synthetic win theme.

intelligence_processing.name: Proposal compilation and readiness
intelligence_processing.detail: Produces a package outline, required review checklist, delivery summary, and synthetic win-probability indicator.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Account executives, bid managers, and sales leaders invoke six proposal operations through a guided chat experience.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: The same RAPP agent runs locally through Brainstem chat endpoints without customer credentials or live connectors.

clients_user_interface.name: Word and PowerPoint draft surfaces
clients_user_interface.detail: Approved document workflows can receive reviewed structures; the agent does not create or deliver a final proposal.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Teams review
clients_user_interface.detail: Teams is the intended bid-team collaboration surface for human review before any external use.

management_reporting.name: Traceable compliance checklist
management_reporting.detail: Reports requirement IDs, categories, weights, fit scores, evidence, existing assets, and unresolved gaps.

management_reporting.name: Budget and margin review
management_reporting.detail: Shows list and proposed prices, discounts, savings, budget status, headroom, and margin assumptions for approvers.

management_reporting.name: Proposal review checklist
management_reporting.detail: Lists package sections and open legal, pricing, branding, editorial, security, and reference reviews.

management_reporting.name: Draft readiness summary
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes capability fit, implementation, pricing, references, competition, and human-governed next decisions.

tools.name: ProposalGenerationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable Python BasicAgent exposing six read-only operations over bundled synthetic evidence.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes chat, streaming, and health endpoints.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: A deployment-selected model interprets requests and composes grounded responses from agent results.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the draft conversational agent, uploaded knowledge, and six skills; publication requires confirmation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
tools.detail: Approved production seam for opportunity context; no live CRM connection or write is enabled in current evidence.

tools.name: SharePoint
tools.detail: Approved production seam for governed response content; current package uses fixed synthetic knowledge files.

tools.name: Microsoft Word and PowerPoint
tools.detail: Potential reviewed document surfaces for proposal structures; final file generation and delivery stay human-controlled.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Supports bid-team review and coordination; the agent does not send messages or customer communications.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only fail-closed routing
supporting_features.detail: Only bundled evidence and allow-listed RFP names are accepted; unknown sources, identifiers, and operations fail closed.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic calculations
supporting_features.detail: Fixed formulas govern fit, pricing, references, comparisons, and the illustrative win-probability indicator.

supporting_features.name: Evidence boundary labeling
supporting_features.detail: Exact names, values, scores, pricing, margins, timelines, and projections are identified as synthetic evidence.

supporting_features.name: Human approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Legal, finance, pricing, security, brand, editorial, reference, sponsor, and account-owner reviews remain mandatory.

supporting_features.name: Draft and no-write lifecycle
supporting_features.detail: No CRM write, approval, outreach, reference contact, document delivery, submission, or publication occurs automatically.

supporting_features.name: Locked six-case validation
supporting_features.detail: All six persona cases passed strict Brainstem isolation and Copilot Studio preview while the agent remained unpublished.
